Up to 10 pages menu

Article types

  • Research articles should not exceed 8,000 words, including references, tables and figure captions.
  • Short communications: maximum 3000 words and up to 2 figures.
  • Review articles are typically 6000–10000 words long.

Abstract

A concise and factual abstract is required, with a maximum length of 250 words. Please provide 1 to 7 keywords.

Manuscript length

Papers must not exceed 25 double-spaced pages. Manuscripts should include no more than 50 references.

Use 12-point font and 2.5 cm margins.

The journal has published 1500 articles since 1990.
